call_sites: scripts/edge_consistency_table.py:144 the only production caller of edge_consistency()
nova/imas/mast_parity_chain.py:34 imports grid_current_density from the same module, unchanged by this diff

findings.text: the fragment states that the grid current integrates to the slice's own Ip within 0.3 per cent on all 72 sampled slices, which the node's own receipt contradicts -- table.json shows grid_current_integral_ratio spanning 0.9736 to 1.0027 on DINA 105052/1 and 0.9801 to 1.0019 on DINA 105069/3, a worst deviation of 2.64 per cent -- and the same sentence is repeated at docs/research/dd-cocos-census.html:88 and named as one of the three things the recommendation rests on.

the assertion that profile_current_ratio is approximately 1.0 cannot fail, because the fixture writes its own DD3 file negating the same rows the reader negates, so write and read share one convention and the round trip is closed; the real sources read about minus 1.1 in table.json, so no test covers the sign discrepancy the node itself reports.

the x64 refusal is never exercised -- tests/test_edge_consistency.py:37 and tests/test_edge_consistency_ids_route.py:41 both call configure_dtypes() at import, so the guard could be deleted with all three arms still green, and the already-correct guard was verified rather than made to fire.

_uniform re-implements the endpoint-preserving uniform-axis reconstruction the repository owns at nova/media/sources/mast_efit.py:49 and validates at nova/equilibrium/map_extraction.py:109, extending neither owner; the substantive capability is properly delegated to grid_current_density, which is why this is a helper duplication rather than a fork of the measure.

the log's first line names revision b0c-1b3b66-mutated, which resolves to no commit, and the mutation was applied to the test's own assertion at tests/test_edge_consistency_ids_route.py:298 rather than to the code under test, so the red log shows the assertion is exercised by the measured 2.3309e-3 but not that a code regression would redden it.

item_verdicts.goal: the node goal is the edge-consistency measure reported on the conforming ITER sources with a recommendation for the circuit plan reference; docs/evidence/fragments/dd-cocos-ingest/edge-consistency-table.html:114-124 carries the three-source table and :146-241 the recommendation.
item_verdicts.manifest: read; it records status complete, seven commits beyond the base, the base arm at 14 passed and the head arm at 15 passed with EXIT=0, the ids-route arm at 2 passed EXIT=0, the negative control at EXIT=1, and table.json holding 72 measured slice rows.
item_verdicts.write_paths: the manifest declares eight paths and git diff d246049f5..44a6e239f changes only files inside them (nova/imas/edge_consistency.py, tests/test_edge_consistency.py, tests/test_edge_consistency_ids_route.py, scripts/edge_consistency_table.py, docs/figures/dd-cocos-edge-consistency/render_convergence.py and its SVG, docs/research/dd-cocos-census.html at +8 lines, and the landing fragment).

justifications.durability: the band-denominator test at tests/test_edge_consistency.py:279-283 recomputes the band value from first principles and reddens if the slice-wide maximum is substituted, but the x64 guard at nova/imas/edge_consistency.py:146 is unreachable from any arm and the round-trip fixture at tests/test_edge_consistency_ids_route.py:146 cannot fail on the sign defect the node itself reports.
justifications.evidence: the claim at docs/evidence/fragments/dd-cocos-ingest/edge-consistency-table.html:162 that the grid current integrates to Ip within 0.3 per cent is contradicted by the node's own table.json, whose grid_current_integral_ratio spans 0.9736 to 1.0027 on DINA 105052/1.

justifications.reuse: the capability search over nova/ found the endpoint-preserving uniform axis owned by nova/media/sources/mast_efit.py:49 and validated at nova/equilibrium/map_extraction.py:109, and scripts/edge_consistency_table.py:80 duplicates both as a private _uniform without extending either.
